summary: Reproduced and fix confirmed with no stubs. After a real run had cached its result, running eval/compare_q.py again with --clear_cache at 07ffea7f89c5 (latest affected and fix parent) returned the cached result without evaluating the model. At the fix e1d2fa11d657 the same second run evaluated the model again. This supersedes attempts 001 to 003.
what_ran: repro.py runs the unmodified eval/compare_q.py command twice on GPU 1, first to populate its disk cache and then with --clear_cache, and checks whether the second run printed the Testing line. The model spec includes out_logits, so the three-argument cache key carries a real logits path. Data is 2 rows of 256 tokens from wikitext-2-raw-v1 test (Hub dataset wikitext at b08601e04326c79dfdd32d625aee71d232d685c3), and the model is unquantized Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct.
limits: One model and one spec. A spec without out_logits could not be cached at these commits, because of the separate compare-q-no-reference-finalization defect. Third-party packages are real, resolved as of 2025-06-01 (transformers 4.52.4, datasets 3.6.0, gptqmodel 2.2.0, aqlm 1.1.7, autoawq 0.2.9, vptq 0.0.5.post1, bitsandbytes 0.46.0, exllamav2 0.3.1, llama-cpp-python 0.3.9); logbar, tokenicer and device_smi were added because gptqmodel imports them.
